goal: Prevent identical peer address announcements from falsely inflating an address's multiplicity in AddrMan
Correct the address freshness check to account for the initial time penalty applied to stored entries
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Support because it reduces inflated address reference counts on onion and i2p nodes (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a logic bug where identical gossip announcements inflate address multiplicity up to 8
Benefit is minor because adversarial peers can already bypass this by altering timestamps directly
